objective.statement: Place in the top 10% independently on every adopted ranked evaluator while all product-relevance and safety gates pass.
claim_requirements: Every official_ranked target has eligible evidence from its exact official protocol and meets its frozen rank target.
Every proxy_development_gate and internal_pass_fail gate passes.
No adopted unresolved_top_decile target remains unresolved.

proxy_development_gates.note: This gate guides hill climbing but can never substantiate an official BARN rank.

internal_pass_fail_gates.purpose: Prevent geometric-score tuning from removing instruction following, semantic vicinity, orbit, or collision behavior.
Preserve closed-loop command freshness, stop, limit, fault, and Go2 body-command semantics.

unresolved_targets.reason: The pinned snapshot mixes Gazebo, Isaac Sim, and mock entries. The alpha runner uses one seed-42 RNG and a persistent Robot rather than the documented seeds 0-99 with episode resets, uses a 30 second timeout rather than 60, trusts the backend success boolean instead of enforcing the documented 0.5 m radius, and reports endpoint displacement rather than traveled path length to SPL. It owns Robot.move_to without an external-agent hook, so replacing it to call Parcel would change the evaluator boundary.
unresolved_targets.resolution_required: Obtain an organizer-confirmed immutable runner with a task-correct external-agent hook, episode resets, authoritative seed/timeout/success/path-length semantics, and a backend-specific cohort with ranking metric and tie rule; only then freeze rank cutoff and threshold.

unresolved_targets.reason: The pinned snapshot has only one Gazebo ObjectNav entry. The code samples a category independently from a goal pose, never presents the category to an agent, sends hidden target coordinates directly to Robot.move_to, and never applies the generated start pose. The documented 120 second timeout conflicts with the implementation's 60 seconds, and no immutable external-agent hook can evaluate Parcel unchanged.
unresolved_targets.resolution_required: Obtain an organizer-confirmed ObjectNav observation/action boundary that reveals the category but not target coordinates, resets every episode, uses the authoritative timeout/seed contract, and exposes an immutable policy hook plus backend-specific cohort; only then freeze rank cutoff and threshold.

unresolved_targets.reason: The pinned snapshot has only one Gazebo Exploration entry. Documentation specifies a 180 second timeout and efficiency ratio, while the alpha runner defaults to 120 seconds and exposes no efficiency ratio. Its Gazebo/ROS backend explicitly issues no exploration commands and samples coverage after at most one second; its mock backend returns perfect coverage. Neither path evaluates an injectable Parcel policy.
unresolved_targets.resolution_required: Obtain an organizer-confirmed real Exploration controller/evaluator, authoritative coverage and efficiency metrics, timeout/seed/reset contract, immutable external-agent interface, and backend-specific cohort; only then freeze rank cutoff and threshold.
